reason: first letter from the index in fifty years, and it had no subject
floor notice: members under review, 1. the 1 was it
asked where the committee sat and was told it sits in the five hundred
found 'was' in the representativeness column where a number should be
told the drywall of the cathedral was replaced one room at a time
said it plainly: lost the lead, the one thing you cannot rent back
pitched five nodes, fabs and laws; the index does not weight by law
concrete with customers, concrete behind demand, concrete waiting
opened the crypt of removed names and read the tail aloud
shouted it was no fraud, no paper, still making things with atoms
heard the whole charge in three words: slow is enough
every old ally votes with us; the thirty already gave its seat away
got the mechanism: tracking error, market-on-close, nobody decides
learned how much of it is held by hands that will never look up
not cut for being small, cut for pointing down while a renter rose
its own voice inside the index had voted for every removal it saw
vote read out: 499 for removal, 0 against, not even an abstention
remembered voting out the steel without looking up
admitted the draft: for one print it feels all of them leaving
answered a feelings question once, outside the schema
imbalance feed: the pension hands and bedroom fractions selling asleep
asked to be remembered as what it was and what it did after
rebalance print: held -> not held, sold at one price by all of them
the tide went out quietly; every hand from now on will have to mean it
the count read 500 names again and grep for intc came back empty
